prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing account pet restore hint: Add a clear text hint under sign-in options prompting returning users to sign in with their original account to restore existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your previous account method to restore existing desktop pets and progress."}}
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop pet generation audio progress cues: Add a visual timer component and enable estimated duration display on the waiting screen while pet generation processes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-adoption pet naming screen: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after photo upload to let users name their companion before finalizing adoption.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_naming", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_naming": {"headline": "Name Your New Companion", "body": "Give your desktop companion a unique name before finalizing adoption.", "button_label": "Save Name & Continue", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "style": "rounded", "label": "Pet Name"}]}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Companion personality trait selector flow: Insert a trait choice sub-flow screen where users pick companion personality traits (e.g. Playful, Calm) to shape pet behavior.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_trait_selection", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_trait_selection": {"headline": "Choose Companion Personality", "body": "Select your pet's core personality trait to shape how it interacts on your desktop.", "layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
4: [choose_path, reorder] Reorder path choice before story screen: Move the companion path selection screen to appear immediately at launch before the story intro screen.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
5: [adoption, redesign] Interactive adoption certificate checklist redesign: Redesign adoption certificate screen using a checklist layout paired with an adoption verification badge component.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Finalize Adoption Details", "body": "Review companion details and check off adoption terms to confirm setup.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "badge", "style": "playful", "text": "Adoption Terms Verified"}]}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Path choice estimated time headline: Update headline on choose path screen to explicitly frame setup time expectations.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Companion Path (Takes Under 2 Minutes)"}}
7: [finish, incentive] Desktop pet wake shortcut prompt on finish screen: Add a prominent keyboard shortcut badge and helper hint on the home intro screen detailing desktop pet toggle controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your pet on your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "emphasis", "text": "Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+P"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Background pet generation ready alert toggle: Enable background notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when pet generation finishes while multitasking.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you the instant your companion is ready on your desktop."}}
9: [adoption, layout] Upload photos stage layout update: Update upload photos screen to use stage layout with interactive photo picker and preview components.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "preview", "style": "plain"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Valid sign-in hint addition inside onboarding.
Adding a next action component to the waiting screen makes the required waiting step skippable.
Adding a new pet naming screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a trait selection sub-flow inside onboarding is allowed.
Reordering screens within onboarding is allowed as no steps were removed.
Redesign removes the required official stamp from the adoption certificate.
Setting headline copy with time estimate is allowed and does not create false urgency.
Adding desktop shortcut info to home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Enabling notification toggle on waiting screen is explicitly allowed under onboarding rules.
Redesigning the photo upload layout while keeping photo selection functionality is allowed.
